about: Texts OCR reads at one place on labels of a layout: the line's reading start in mm from the label's top left (main's label model), the reading direction (turn: 0 = left to right, 90 = down, 270 = up), and its length (when it's always read whole) or height in mm, for the scale. Measured 2026-11-09 on the sample's RapidOCR lines against main's accepted label fits. 'needs': when it may place a label (non-JPN serial: its own serial, or one on the label photo, isn't Japanese).

texts.name: MADE IN JAPAN on the strip
